decks.notes: The deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful combination of artifacts and spells to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage through Paradoxical Outcome. This allows the player to draw more cards, generate more mana, and control the game with cards like Force of Will. The deck includes several key pieces like Mishra's Workshop, The One Ring, and Tinker to efficiently set up the combo and win the game through overwhelming resource advantage and powerful artifact synergies.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Coveted Jewel and various cards to generate mana quickly and draw cards in order to win the game. It uses artifacts like The One Ring and Mana Vault to generate mana, while cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Mystic Forge help to draw cards and set up the combo. It also includes control elements like Force of Will and Trinisphere to protect the combo. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its card advantage and mana generation.

This deck focuses on using a combination of powerful control spells and disruptive creatures to outmaneuver and control the opponent's game plan. By leveraging cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. The inclusion of powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen provide additional mana acceleration, allowing the deck to play its threats and control spells efficiently.

This deck focuses on leveraging artifacts and card draw to quickly generate a large amount of mana and card advantage, ultimately leading to a game-winning combo using cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Time Vault. Key components include Moxen, Lotus, and artifact lands to ramp up quickly, along with counterspells like Force of Will to protect the combo pieces. Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing you to recast important cards from your graveyard. The deck aims to control the game with a mix of disruption and powerful combos to win in a decisive manner.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, card advantage, and disrupting the opponent's strategy. It aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently answering threats and drawing cards while gradually taking control of the game. The combination of disruptive cards like Force of Will and Fatal Push, along with powerful card draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, allows the deck to dictate the pace of the game and outmaneuver the opponent. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's plans while maintaining card advantage and board control.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed for the Doomsday win condition. By efficiently using cards like Dark Ritual, Demonic Tutor, and Force of Will, the deck aims to set up a powerful Doomsday pile that will allow the player to win the game on the following turn. The deck is focused on manipulating the graveyard and drawing cards to find the necessary combo pieces, while also maintaining control of the game through counter magic and disruption spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through disruption and card advantage, using powerful spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to deal with threats. It also utilizes cards like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Nihil Spellbomb to shut down opponents' strategies. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value by allowing the player to recast low-cost permanents from the graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent while maintaining control of the game state to secure victory.

The focus of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value to be gained from recurring low cmc permanents. The deck also includes powerful vintage staples like Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Time Walk to gain additional card advantage and tempo advantage. By maintaining control of the game and disrupting the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Coveted Jewel, The One Ring, and various mana acceleration cards such as Grim Monolith and Ancient Tomb. By generating large amounts of mana quickly and using cards like Paradoxical Outcome to draw into key pieces, the deck aims to create a dominant board state and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of powerful artifacts like Tinker, Karn, the Great Creator, and Time Vault allows for additional avenues to victory, making the deck versatile and difficult to predict.

This Esper Control deck focuses on card advantage and disruption, utilizing cards like Brainstorm, Dig Through Time, and Treasure Cruise to dig through the deck while using Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will to control the board. Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides a recurring threat, while cards like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Psychic Frog help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes various mana denial cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine, along with powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen to accelerate into game-winning plays.

The deck revolves around creating a powerful board state with early artifact mana and utilizing powerful combo pieces like Coveted Jewel, Time Vault, and The One Ring. It aims to control the game with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor, while utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome to draw into its combo pieces quickly. The deck also features cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Urza's Saga to tutor for specific artifacts and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Its ultimate goal is to assemble a game-winning combo and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful artifacts and spells.

This deck revolves around assembling the combo pieces necessary to execute a powerful Doomsday win condition. The deck uses various tutors and cantrips to dig through the deck quickly, while also utilizing disruption spells like Flusterstorm and Force of Will to protect the combo. Key cards like Thassa's Oracle, Doomsday, and Demonic Consultation are critical to the deck's success, allowing for a quick and efficient win once the combo is assembled. The deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn, catching opponents off guard and securing victory.

The deck revolves around using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly dump cards into the graveyard, enabling powerful graveyard-based combos. The goal is to maximize the use of dredge mechanics to quickly fill the graveyard with key cards like Creeping Chill, Narcomoeba, and Prized Amalgam. By utilizing cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation for protection, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of graveyard recursion and powerful creatures. The deck has a strong focus on graveyard manipulation and leveraging it to its advantage in order to win the game.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter spells and removal while gaining card advantage through card draw and manipulation. Utilizing powerful cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Wasteland, the deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent over the course of the game. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and recursion, enhancing the deck's resilience and consistency. Overall, the deck aims to grind out incremental advantages to eventually overpower the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat out large creatures early in the game, effectively controlling the board. It also includes cards like Gitaxian Probe, Narset, Parter of Veils, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck features powerful cards like Bolas's Citadel, Oko, Thief of Crowns, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Show and Tell, Tinker, and The One Ring offer alternative win conditions and powerful combos to effectively control the game.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hate cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere. It aims to control the board with cards like Archon of Emeria and Chancellor of the Annex, while also being able to generate mana advantage with cards like Ancient Tomb and Moxen. The deck also includes cards like Anointed Peacekeeper and Stillmoon Cavalier to protect against aggressive strategies. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while controlling the opponent's resources, leading to a strong aggressive gameplay.
